title: Simple Present Tense
theory:
Uses
        Simple Present (Present Indefinite) tense is used to express:

       1 Routine Action → Ravi goes to school every day.
       2 Irregular Action → She seldom visits her grandparents.
       3 Habits → Rahul drinks tea every morning.
       4 Universal Truth → The sun rises in the east.
       5 General Facts → Water boils at 100°C.
       6 Geographical Truth → The Ganga flows into the Bay of Bengal.
       7 Stative Verbs → I believe your story.
       8 Socially Accepted Belief → Girls are more sincere than boys.
       9 Proverbs → Honesty pays in the long run.
      10 Fixed Schedule → The train leaves at 6 P.M.

       Keywords
    With keywords like daily, usually, often, always, every day, every morning, every week, once
    a week, twice a day, seldom, rarely, sometimes, generally, frequently, occasionally, never,
    barely, hardly, scarcely, repeatedly etc., we use Present Indefinite Tense.

      Structure
         Subject + V1/ (V1 + s/es) + Object.
         Subject + do/does + not + V1 + Object.
         Do/does + Subject + not + V1 + Object?
         WH word + do/does + Subject + not + V1 + Object?

       Note
      I/ We/ You/ They/ Plural noun → V1/ do
      He/ She/ It/ Singular noun → (V1 + s/es)/ does
